failure.test: Memory integrity rejects an in-place source change after the real Atlas capture reader awaited
failure.cause: The real C08 snapshot changes after the canonical capture read. The helper waits until its final stable() fence before detecting it, allowing router.proveContinuity to enter a reader refresh that poisons C08 with a nested write.
failure.testInjection: The fixture mutates the actual outer transaction snapshot and returns commit:false. It does not create a nested write.
failure.requiredDelta: Check stable() immediately after pinning the real capture result, before continuity or any further reader await.
